preconditions.name: sws_context_memory_writes_occur
preconditions.control: sum of ContextMemory.write() calls (sws_n_writes) across every SWS_THEN_REM sleep pass, pooled across all 5 seeds. Unchanged from 436c-436f.

preconditions.name: rem_attribution_rollouts_occur
preconditions.control: sum of hippocampal replay rollouts (rem_n_rollouts) across every SWS_THEN_REM sleep pass, pooled across all 5 seeds. Unchanged from 436c-436f.

preconditions.name: waking_writepath_engaged
preconditions.control: sum of ContextMemory.write() calls fired by the per-tick sense_only hook across all WAKING_ONLY seeds, pooled across all 5 seeds. Unchanged from 436e/436f.

preconditions.name: sufficient_occupancy_for_c1
preconditions.control: count of seeds (of 5) where BOTH WAKING_ONLY and SWS_THEN_REM have >=2 occupied slots (the minimum for an off-diagonal pairwise mean to exist). Unchanged from 436e/436f -- expected to clear decisively under BIAS write-selection per V3-EXQ-943's substrate-validation reading (16/16 occupied slots on 5/5 seeds).

preconditions.name: adam_drift_neutralized
preconditions.control: max |z-score| of the NO_WRITES calibration arm's raw whole-bank cosine against the freshly-derived untouched-bank null (mean=0.000019, sd=0.007789, n_draws=500), across all 5 seeds. Unchanged from 436e/436f.

preconditions.name: bias_occupancy_confirms_fix
preconditions.control: min per-seed n_occupied_slots across ALL non-NO_WRITES cells (WAKING_ONLY + SWS_THEN_REM, 5 seeds each) -- NEW in 436g, the direct empirical confirmation that BIAS write-selection (contextmemory_write_usage_balancing=True) actually cleared the occupancy floor in THIS driver's own env/training-loop configuration, not merely in V3-EXQ-943's substrate-validation harness.
